poem.author: 王维
englishLines: Alone I sit among the quiet bamboo,
Playing the qin, then singing a long clear note.
No one knows I am deep in the grove,
But the bright moon comes to shine on me.

appreciation.zh: 幽静竹林里没有旁人，琴声、清啸和月光却让独处变成自在又明亮的陪伴。
appreciation.en: With no one else in the quiet bamboo grove, music, a clear call, and moonlight turn solitude into peaceful companionship.

pages.zhText:
独坐幽篁里，
弹琴复长啸。
深林人不知，
明月来相照。
pages.enText:
Alone I sit among the quiet bamboo,
Playing the qin, then singing a long clear note.
No one knows I am deep in the grove,
But the bright moon comes to shine on me.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Peaceful night in a deep Tang bamboo grove, Wang Wei in muted celadon scholar robe sits on a low woven mat playing a seven-string guqin placed correctly on a simple low stand, full moonlight pours between tall bamboo stalks, small stone and ferns nearby, spacious and child-friendly, no text in image.

pages.zhText:
独坐幽篁里，
诗人一个人坐在幽静的竹林深处。
pages.enText:
Alone I sit among the quiet bamboo.
The poet settles by himself deep inside the peaceful grove.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide dusk-to-night view of the same poet seated calmly on the mat among many tall blue-green bamboo stems, the guqin resting before him and a narrow safe path disappearing behind, elegant negative space, no text in image.

pages.zhText:
弹琴复长啸。
他轻轻拨动琴弦，又舒展地唱出一声悠长的清音。
pages.enText:
Playing the qin, then singing a long clear note.
He plucks the strings and lets one free, clear note travel through the grove.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Medium view of the same poet's hands correctly and gently playing the guqin, then lifting his face to release a calm melodic call, bamboo leaves and a tiny night bird responding to the sound, no musical symbols or text in image.

pages.zhText:
深林人不知，
竹林太深了，外面的人不知道这里藏着琴声。
pages.enText:
No one knows I am deep in the grove.
The bamboo is so deep that people outside do not know where the music begins.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Long view through layered bamboo trunks, the same poet and guqin appearing small in a secluded moonlit clearing far from a quiet empty path outside, safe serene solitude, no text in image.

pages.zhText:
明月来相照。
可月亮找到了他，把清亮的光送进竹林。
pages.enText:
But the bright moon comes to shine on me.
The moon finds him and sends clear light into the bamboo.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Upward-angled scene as the full moon appears in an opening between bamboo leaves and a soft silver beam reaches the same poet, guqin and woven mat, his face brightening with quiet delight, no text in image.

pages.zhText: 眼前是竹影和月光，耳边是琴声和清啸。安静的夜里，其实有许多声音在互相回答。
pages.enText: Bamboo shadows and moonlight fill the eyes; qin strings and a clear call fill the ears. The quiet night is answering in many ways.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Immersive circular composition around the same poet: moonlit bamboo shadows cross the ground, guqin strings vibrate subtly, leaves stir and a small stream glints nearby, natural responses without drawn sound marks, no text in image.

pages.zhText: 一个人也不一定孤单。能听见风、看见月亮，心就可以安安静静地舒展开。
pages.enText: Being alone does not always mean being lonely. Wind and moonlight can give the heart room to unfold.
pages.illustrationPrompt: The same poet rests his hands on the guqin after playing, shoulders relaxed and gentle smile under moonlight, bamboo canopy opening to a calm starless blue sky, comforting rather than lonely, no text in image.

pages.zhText:
独坐幽篁里，
弹琴复长啸。
深林人不知，
明月来相照。
再轻轻读一遍吧。
pages.enText:
Alone I sit among the quiet bamboo,
Playing the qin, then singing a long clear note.
No one knows I am deep in the grove,
But the bright moon comes to shine on me.
Now read it softly once more.
